text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Oh? What was this DVD again, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I don't recall buying this, though...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—...! Oh no! I borrowed this from a friend 
before coming to Japan and forgot to 
return it...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I can't believe I forgot... I have to 
apologize to her...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart had her apology accepted and 
sent the DVD back via international mail, 
but she was still feeling down.
